units: ASTRA native metres; Blender frame (x, y, z) = three (x, -z, y)
method: every vertex of every exported mesh except the door frame ring + leaf: (1) analytic envelope = intended arch r <= 1.455 about the axis (Blender y 0, z 0.213; rib inner edge 1.475 - 2 cm), |x| <= 2.16 (cap frame bars 2.18 - 2 cm), z >= deck top 0.232 - 2 mm; (2) BVH nearest distance >= 2 cm to every ASTRA shell mesh that stays in the game after the HANDOFF hide/cut rule (deck/skid/contact shadow excluded: furniture stands on the deck)
